symbols.name: input length
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two integers being multiplied, which is the length the worst-case time is measured against.
symbols.quote: Here $n$ is the number of bits in each of the two integers being multiplied.

symbols.name: power-saving constant
symbols.meaning: A fixed constant greater than 0 that does not depend on $n$.
symbols.quote: Its worst-case time is $O(n(\lg n)^{1-\kappa})$ for a fixed constant $\kappa>0$, and its exponent $1-\kappa$ on $\lg n$ is less than 1.

relations.quote: The conjecture is posed for multitape machines and is contrasted with the [fixed-tape machine model](fixed-tape-model.md), in which the target result is measured.
